import pandas as pd
import statsmodels.api as sm

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('table_name.csv')

# Define the independent variables (predictors) and dependent variable (response)
X = df[['Indices of Deprivation 2015 - South East U.A.s (n.b. Rank 1 = most deprived).1',
        'Indices of Deprivation 2015 - South East U.A.s (n.b. Rank 1 = most deprived).3']]
Y = df['Indices of Deprivation 2015 - South East U.A.s (n.b. Rank 1 = most deprived).9']

# Add a constant to the model (intercept)
X = sm.add_constant(X)

# Fit the OLS regression model
model = sm.OLS(Y, X).fit()

# Print the summary of the regression model
print(model.summary())
